serverInfo.name: ampworth-calculators
serverInfo.title: UK home energy calculators, following the MCS standards
serverInfo.description: Two whole-system sizing calculators, one for solar and one for heat pumps, that work from a household's own bills to the system it needs, plus nine calculators that each implement one published method: solar PV output and shading, self-consumption, heat pump noise, room heat loss, radiator flow temperature, hot water cylinder sizing and heat pump running cost from the MCS standards, and the network connection route under the ENA's G98 and G99.
